lines: Karan Aggarwal, Promoter, holds 44,82,392 shares and is not selling in this offer.
Retained stake is worth ₹67.24 crore (estimate, valued at offer price), shares not cash.
Discuss how the retained stake could be positioned, since the offer leaves their holding intact.
Timing of any future access is unknown: lock-in rule not found in this event's documents.
